description.en: Fades an array of stand-event dialogue models in or out together, waiting for the fade to finish before returning (enabling them before fading in, disabling them after fading out).
Array of dialogue model handles to fade together.
Target alpha; greater than 0 fades in, 0 or less fades out.
Optional fade duration in frames (defaults to 10).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.
